metadata.title: Finitely many solutions for the prescribed scalar curvature problem at the critical flatness order
metadata.abstract: We study the following prescribed scalar curvature problem $$ -\Delta u=K(y)u^{2^*-1},\ \ u>0 \,\ \ \text{in}\ \ \mathbb{R}^N, \tag*{$(*)$} $$ where $2^*=\frac{2N}{N-2}$. For $N\geq4$, we construct a positive $K(y)$ with maximum set $\{|y|=1\}$ and critical order of flatness $m=N-2$ at $|y|=1$, such that problem $(*)$ admits only finitely many positive solutions in $D^{1,2}(\mathbb{R}^N)$. To this end, we prove compactness of the solution set of $(*)$ by blow-up analysis and then apply Sard's theorem to choose $K$ for which each solution is nondegenerate and hence isolated, so that the solution set of $(*)$ is finite. Our results give a negative answer to Wei--Yan's conjecture in [J. Wei and S. Yan, JFA, 2010].

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对 N≥4 构造 C² 正函数 K，其最大集为单位球面且平坦阶恰为 N−2；在径向主项外的环带加入任意小光滑扰动，得到仅有限个 D¹,² 正解的规定曲率问题。
analysis.breakthrough: 对 N≥4 选择 K，使 D¹,²(R^N) 中正解仅有限个，从而否定所述 Wei–Yan 猜想。
analysis.limitations: 有限解集明确允许为空，因此不是证明有限个正解必然存在。反例针对最大集为正维子流形的一般 Wei–Yan 猜想，不否定更低平坦阶及额外对称假设下的无限解定理；未逐步核验爆破解析、Kazdan–Warner 排除和 Sard 参数论证。 已补读 Conjecture A、Theorems 1.1–1.2 与非退化扰动，不是对整篇证明的独立核验。

analysis.priorityReason: 清楚界定几何 PDE 中无限解预期失效的临界情形。
